topic.title: Water Resources Management Plans / Drought Plans / Supply-Demand Balance
topic.source_contract: water company and resource-zone identity, adopted WRMP and drought-plan versions, demand forecast, deployable output, headroom, leakage and consumption assumptions, climate and abstraction changes, supply-demand balance, options, environmental assessment, funding, delivery, annual review and performance evidence

scope_guards: A regional forecast is not an exact resource-zone balance.
A draft WRMP is not an adopted company plan.
A preferred option is not a funded delivered scheme.
A drought action is not a permanent supply increase.
Population growth is not evidence of network capacity.
Planning permission is not a water-supply commitment.
Annual review commitments are not measured performance.
No score or promotion is written without exact zone, adopted plan, funded delivery and performance evidence.
